title: Track Events Responses
description: Responses to a request to create or modify Track Events

all_successful.description: A value of 'true' indicates that all Track Events included in the request were processed successfully and so all entries in `responses` have a 2xx `http_status_code` (indicating success). A value of 'false' indicates that an error occurred when processing at least one Track Event in the request.

responses.description: Ordered list of Track Event responses. There must be one entry in `responses` for each Track Event in the request, and they must be in the same order.

http_status_code.description: The HTTP response status code to indicate the outcome of processing the Track Event in the request.

id.description: The Track Event identifier. `id` should be present whenever available. `id` must be present if an identifier was present for the Track Event in the request.

error.description: Provides more information in the case of error, as described by the [Error](#/schemas/error) type
